summary: Comprehensive testing of Playwright Scraping Workbench completed. Backend APIs fully functional with 97.4% success rate. Frontend UI working well with minor dropdown overlay issue in job creation form.

minor_bugs.issue: Input validation too permissive - accepts empty job data
minor_bugs.impact: Should return 422 for invalid data but returns 200

ui_bugs.issue: Dropdown overlay blocks submit button interaction

passed_tests: Dashboard loads with stats (4 stat cards displayed)
Navigation works between all pages (Jobs, Templates, Settings)
Templates CRUD - create, edit, delete operations work
Settings page - proxy list and API key inputs functional
Job form basic inputs and add/remove functionality
Template creation with selectors and pagination
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix dropdown overlay issue in job creation form - captcha selector dropdown blocks submit button. Also consider adding stricter input validation for job creation API.
